item.title: CEO of Indianapolis Zoo steps down after leave of absence
item.description: Dr. Rob Shumaker, the President and CEO of the Indianapolis Zoo, has stepped down after serving for over 16 years.

item.title: UAE intercepts Iranian fire; Israel steps up strikes on Tehran, Beirut
item.description: The UAE closed its airspace briefly as its military intercepted incoming Iranian fire, while Israel launched new attacks on Tehran and Hezbollah militants in Lebanon, causing fears of a global energy crisis and prompting the U.S. to seek help from allies to keep the Strait of Hormuz open.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz conflict threatens fertilizer supplies to US farmers
item.description: The conflict in the Strait of Hormuz has disrupted global fertilizer shipping, causing price surges and supply concerns for American farmers as the spring planting season begins.

item.title: Transportation Security at IND airport holds steady amid partial shutdown
item.description: Transportation Security Administration agents at Indianapolis International Airport are struggling to make ends meet due to the Department of Homeland Security shutdown. Many have to save money for gas, and some have called out sick to save money. Senate Democrats are holding up funding over the Trump administration's immigrant removal actions and the shootings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti in Minneapolis.

item.title: Harry Connick Jr. to return to Carmel for July show
item.description: Grammy and Emmy Award-winning singer Harry Connick Jr. this summer will return to Carmel, Indiana, for a performance at the Payne & Mencias Palladium, featuring jazz standards and original hits.

item.title: 3 arrested, juvenile detained after ATM theft, police chase in Crawfordsville
item.description: Four people from Texas and Louisiana were apprehended after attempting to steal an ATM from a bank in Crawfordsville, Indiana, leading to a vehicle pursuit and crash, authorities say.

item.title: Indiana task force arrests 2 19-year-olds, alleges they had illegal weapons
item.description: The Indiana Crime Guns Task Force arrested two 19-year-old men from Indianapolis, accusing them of having stolen weapons, and a machine gun conversion device.

item.title: Scientists debunk claims of marijuana as anxiety, mental health treatment
item.description: Two newly-released analyses of existing research have found no evidence that marijuana is effective in treating anxiety, depression, or other mental health conditions, and its use can be dangerous, especially for vulnerable populations.

item.title: Transformation coming to downtown section of I-65 and I-70
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — Civic leaders in Indianapolis unveiled a plan to transform a key downtown section of I‑65 and I‑70 to boost safety and connectivity. The Southeast Gateway study proposes recessing and capping the interstate between Washington and Prospect streets and East and Shelby streets.
